plan.purpose: After the selector stop, localize the source loss to static output restrictions or adaptive setting choices.
plan.hypothesis: The unrestricted bank retains strong-tone accuracy, while the joint check's output restrictions sacrifice it.
plan.design: Full existing 2x5 setting menu: line-finder tones on/off by minimum memory 0/.05/.1/.2/.4 s. Hold each setting fixed by preventing the band check from changing its initial choice. The bank's own internal tracking/choice, existing output gate and all other parameters are unchanged.
plan.metrics: 20/120 ms tone and whole-band gain; every third-octave band change. Report all settings, not only a winner.
plan.limits: Already-seen, outcome-selected four-source diagnosis. Holding the joint setting fixed changes its adaptation, not just transition smoothing. Static winners are hindsight, not deployable replacements.
plan.guard_tradeoff: Never call disabling a protective check an improvement based only on tone gain; retain all amplification results.
plan.scope: Offline only, no playback, capture, downloads, engine changes or fresh validation.
